A translator takes words in one language and says the same thing in another, so a person who speaks the second language understands it. A phrasebook translator looks each phrase up in a book of checked translations, and says plainly when a phrase is not in its book. It translates the phrases it holds, and it does not guess at the rest.

History

People have carried phrasebooks for centuries, small books of useful sentences in another language for travellers. The first machine translation test, the Georgetown-IBM experiment of 1954, turned sixty Russian sentences into English with a small dictionary and a few rules. Early systems worked by rules written by hand, later systems learned from large collections of translated text, and from 2016 the leading systems learned from whole sentences at once. Phrasebooks never went away: a short list of real phrases, checked by a speaker, is still the most trusted way to say hello, ask the way, and order food abroad. The public references this database cites, the Wikipedia articles on machine translation and phrasebooks, carry that history forward, and every record here names its source. """Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 1: What a Translator Does.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "What a Translator Does"
QUERY_WORDS = 'what translator does'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 1: What a Translator Does")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 6: Days of the Week in Four Languages.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Days of the Week in Four Languages"
QUERY_WORDS = 'days week four languages'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 6: Days of the Week in Four Languages")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 11: Hello and Goodbye.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Hello and Goodbye"
QUERY_WORDS = 'hello goodbye'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 11: Hello and Goodbye")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 16: Big and Small, Hot and Cold.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Big and Small, Hot and Cold"
QUERY_WORDS = 'small cold'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 16: Big and Small, Hot and Cold")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

A phrasebook works by lookup: the traveller finds the phrase they want in their own language and reads the translation beside it. The book holds phrases that were checked by a speaker, so the translation is trusted. It does not build new sentences from single words, and it does not translate a sentence it has never seen; it says plainly that the phrase is not in the book.

History

People have carried phrasebooks for centuries, small books of useful sentences in another language for travellers. The first machine translation test, the Georgetown-IBM experiment of 1954, turned sixty Russian sentences into English with a small dictionary and a few rules. Early systems worked by rules written by hand, later systems learned from large collections of translated text, and from 2016 the leading systems learned from whole sentences at once. Phrasebooks never went away: a short list of real phrases, checked by a speaker, is still the most trusted way to say hello, ask the way, and order food abroad. """Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 21: Reading a Menu.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Reading a Menu"
QUERY_WORDS = 'reading menu'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 21: Reading a Menu")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

QUERY_WORDS = 'what phrasebook cannot translate'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},

def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()

program:
"""Phrasebook demo for the Translator Service record 24: The Translator Service Field Guide Index.
A small working phrasebook translator: a table of checked phrases in
four languages, translating this record's own title words where it can,
and saying plainly what it does not cover."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "The Translator Service Field Guide Index"
QUERY_WORDS = 'translator service field guide index'
PHRASES = {
    "hello": {"es": "hola", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Hallo", "it": "ciao"},
    "good morning": {"es": "buenos dias", "fr": "bonjour", "de": "Guten Morgen", "it": "buongiorno"},
    "goodbye": {"es": "adios", "fr": "au revoir", "de": "auf Wiedersehen", "it": "arrivederci"},
    "please": {"es": "por favor", "fr": "s'il vous plait", "de": "bitte", "it": "per favore"},
    "thank you": {"es": "gracias", "fr": "merci", "de": "danke", "it": "grazie"},
    "sorry": {"es": "lo siento", "fr": "desole", "de": "es tut mir leid", "it": "mi dispiace"},
    "yes": {"es": "si", "fr": "oui", "de": "ja", "it": "si"},
    "no": {"es": "no", "fr": "non", "de": "nein", "it": "no"},
    "water": {"es": "agua", "fr": "eau", "de": "Wasser", "it": "acqua"},
    "bread": {"es": "pan", "fr": "pain", "de": "Brot", "it": "pane"},
    "coffee": {"es": "cafe", "fr": "cafe", "de": "Kaffee", "it": "caffe"},
    "help": {"es": "ayuda", "fr": "au secours", "de": "Hilfe", "it": "aiuto"},
}
def translate(text, lang):
    low = text.lower().strip()
    if low in PHRASES:
        return PHRASES[low][lang]
    words = low.split()
    out = []
    for w in words:
        if w in PHRASES:
            out.append(PHRASES[w][lang])
        else:
            out.append("[" + w + ": not in this phrasebook]")
    return " ".join(out)
print("Translator Service phrasebook demo - record 24: The Translator Service Field Guide Index")
print("Phrasebook entries: %d" % len(PHRASES))
for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"):
    print("  hello -> %s (%s)" % (translate("hello", lang), lang))
print("Query words: " + QUERY_WORDS)
print("Spanish: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "es"))
print("French: " + translate(QUERY_WORDS, "fr"))
joined = "|".join(translate("hello", lang) for lang in ("es", "fr", "de", "it"))
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: 'hello' in Spanish is 'hola' - " + ("pass" if translate("hello", "es") == "hola" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'thank you' in French is 'merci' - " + ("pass" if translate("thank you", "fr") == "merci" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'goodbye' in German is 'auf Wiedersehen' - " + ("pass" if translate("goodbye", "de") == "auf Wiedersehen" else "fail"))
print("Test: 'water' in Italian is 'acqua' - " + ("pass" if translate("water", "it") == "acqua" else "fail"))
print("Test: an unknown word is marked not in the phrasebook - " + ("pass" if "not in this phrasebook" in translate("zqxwv", "es") else "fail"))
print("Test: translation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
